info.name: URL Shortener V4
info.description:
Runs the API end to end against a local backend: auth, links, redirects, plans, guests and analytics.

Requires the backend to run with DEV_PLAN_SWITCH_ENABLED=true, because the plan requests switch
the test user between plans without payment. Each run registers a new user and guest ID, so it can
be run repeatedly. Run in order: later requests use IDs and tokens saved by earlier ones.
